rationale: No existing spec exercises the panel-notice system (chips, tooltip bodies, notice actions, Query Inspector notice banners). The closest matches cover only the two legacy warning icons that pre-date the notices: maxquery.spec.js covers the max-query-range warning icon (panel-max-duration-warning) and dashboard-exemplars.spec.js covers the exemplar-error icon (dashboard-panel-exemplars-error). Both are explicitly de-duplicated out of the new plan. visualize-vrl.spec.js proves VRL-function setup patterns but never asserts a function-error notice. queryInspectorHelpers.js / dashboard-multi-sql.js open the Query Inspector but assert only stats/time, never the notice banners. The notice system is therefore a new area -> new spec at the run-context spec_path, registered into the Dashboards-Core group (where maxquery.spec.js already lives). Single feature area (Dashboards only), no cross-area Frankenstein risk.
